Loops.Title: Loops
Loops.Subtitle: Limits for the agent's think → tool → read loop. Changes apply to the next message.
Loops.Limits.Title: Limits
Loops.Steps.Label: Step limit per turn
Loops.Steps.Tip: The most model round trips one message may take before the agent stops and asks.
Loops.Result.Label: Longest tool result sent back
Loops.Result.Tip: Longer tool output is cut to this length before the model reads it.
Loops.Context.Label: Context budget before compaction
Loops.Context.Tip: When a request would pass this size, old tool results are shortened and earlier turns are summarized.
